integration layer 1: 007-02 builds from C4 (config.ts on 007-01's tokens SCHEMA and private normalizeLeaf; real collision, ordered); 007-03 from its own skeleton C2; 007-05 and 007-06 from C1; 007-05 also integrates after 008-01 (orchestrator order on ingest-finish.ts; separate hunks, re-applied at re-sync). No real collision among the four: the only shared path is src/program.ts (007-02 and 007-06 each append one import and one defaultCommands entry; insert-only, keep both). parallel_eligible n is a hint from the story files

integration layer 2: 008-02 builds from C5 (008-01's Developer commit; its report.ts, report.test.ts and finish report-literal hunks are re-applied on 007-05's at re-sync, in the order counts, archived, wiki); 008-03 and 008-05 from C6 (search files and status.ts and WIKI.md bullets on top of 007-05's; real collisions, ordered); 007-04 from C2. No shared path among the four. Merge 008-02 first (bounce exposure high), then 008-03 before 008-05 (008-05's WIKI.md bullet names --archive)

integration layer 3: 007-07 builds from sprint/S-04 at once (text, allow rules, docs, 0.4.0; no upstream edits its lines; re-syncs on 007-02 to 007-06 for the real-tree checks) and seeds C9; 008-04 builds from C7 (checks.ts, FINISH_CHECKS and finish-lint.test.ts on 007-05's, buildIndex from 008-03; real collisions, ordered) and re-applies its ingest-finish.ts hook hunk beside 008-02's refusal; 009-01 builds from C8 (status.ts and the WIKI.md version bullet on top of 008-05's, plus the K14 skeleton C3) and re-applies its config.ts, doctor.ts (beside 007-02's config-valid branch, decision 66), ingest-start.ts, ingest-plan.ts and test:perf hunks at re-sync. 007-07 and 009-01 share only templates/system/WIKI.md and package.json, in separate hunks (version :3 vs test:perf :46), so this is not a real collision; both package.json arrows involving 007-07 were dropped by the human (2026-10-18); merge 007-07 before 009-01 when both are ready (the accepted WIKI.md order, a merge order only). 009-01's manual check runs on a scratch copy with the version set to 0.4.0 (never committed), since 009-01 may merge before 007-07's bump. From 009-01's merge on, vitest.config.ts applies to every later story
